title: 第21章 恶有恶报开辟阴间法域第22章 传播信仰当以武力开道
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“拜见尊神老爷！”
廖秀儿、廖承平立即跪下，恭敬道。
“尊……尊神老爷？”
“这……这……这是哪里……”
廖熊眼中写满了无助与恐惧，但神威笼罩之下，他根本没有任何反抗之力，直接跪在了堂下，瑟瑟发抖。
他从没有像现在这一刻般恐惧。
甚至他根本就不敢抬头，去看坐在上首那道仿若煌煌烈日的身影！
“廖熊，五年前你将廖秀儿、廖承平推下井中，致两人死亡，可认罪？”
李越淡漠的俯视着廖熊。
“我认罪……”
廖熊颤抖道。
在这神威浩荡的公堂中，他根本没有说谎的勇气。
“既如此——”
“本神判你魂飞魄散之刑。”
李越声音威严。
随着他话音落下。
跪在堂中的廖熊魂魄瞬间散去，灰飞烟灭。
廖秀儿、廖承平脸上都露出激动、喜悦、兴奋之色。
终于——
他们终于报仇了！

五年啊。
足足五年的时间，廖熊这个杀人凶手终于得到了应有报应！
此时此刻。
他们脑海中想到了一句话。
善有善报，恶有恶报；不是不报，时辰未到！
“将此事告知李有鸣。”
“他知道怎么做。”
李越吩咐道。
“谨遵老爷法旨！”
廖秀儿、廖承平学着话本故事上的说法恭恭敬敬领命。
刷——
他们身躯一闪，已经离开了「神域」。
而「神域」中原本阴森公堂的模样也在一瞬间化开，重新变成了空空荡荡的样子。
李越还是喜欢「神域」最初的模样。
什么都没有，一切东西都悬浮在半空。
“既然有了鬼差——”
“他们就该拥有办公之处。”
李越沉吟。
「神域」是他私人的地方，自然不可能让属神、鬼差、阴兵等进进出出。
而作为从九品土地正神，他是有能力开辟出一座「阴间法域」的。

「阴间法域」——
便是专门给属神、鬼差、阴兵等使用的办公之所。
论等阶自然远不如「神域」。
content_en:
"Greetings to the Lord God!"
Liao Xiuer and Liao Chengping immediately knelt down and said respectfully.
"Respect...respect the gods?"
"This...this...where is this..."
Liao Xiong's eyes were filled with helplessness and fear, but under the divine power, he had no power to resist at all and knelt down directly in the hall, trembling.
He had never been as scared as he was now.
He even didn't dare to raise his head to look at the figure sitting above him that looked like the blazing sun!
"Liao Xiong, you pushed Liao Xiuer and Liao Chengping into the well five years ago, causing their death. Can you plead guilty?"
Li Yue looked down at Liao Xiong indifferently.
"I plead guilty..."
Liao Xiong trembled.
In this mighty court, he didn't have the courage to lie at all.
"That being the case——"
"This god sentences you to the punishment of losing your soul."
Li Yue's voice was majestic.
As his words fell.
The soul of Liao Xiong who was kneeling in the hall instantly dispersed and disappeared into ashes.
Liao Xiuer and Liao Chengping both had excitement, joy and excitement on their faces.
Finally——
They finally got their revenge!
Five years.
After five years, Liao Xiong, the murderer, finally got his comeuppance!
At this moment.
A sentence came to their mind.
Good deeds will be rewarded with good deeds, and evil deeds will be rewarded with evil deeds; it’s not that there is no reward, the time has not yet come!
"Inform Li Youming of this matter."
"He knows how to do it."
Li Yue ordered.
"I will obey the master's decree!"
Liao Xiuer and Liao Chengping followed the instructions in the storybook and respectfully accepted their orders.
Brush——
Their bodies flashed and they had left the "God's Domain".
And the original gloomy appearance of the court in "God's Domain" also disappeared in an instant, becoming empty again.
Li Yue still likes the original appearance of "God's Domain".
There is nothing, everything is suspended in mid-air.
"Since there is a ghost—"
"They deserve a place to work."
Li Yue pondered.
"God's Domain" is his private place, so it is naturally impossible for gods, ghosts, evil soldiers, etc. to come in and out.
As a ninth-grade land righteous god, he has the ability to open up a "underworld legal domain".
"The Realm of the Underworld"——
It is an office space specially used by gods, ghosts, evil soldiers, etc.
In terms of level, it is naturally far inferior to "God's Domain".
